Select compounds with selective IC50 activity against JAK2 over JAK1. Filter activities for JAK2 (CHEMBL2971) where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', standard_units is 'nM', and standard_value is less than 50. Filter activities for JAK1 (CHEMBL2835) where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', standard_units is 'nM', and standard_value is greater than 200. Intersect the two compound sets to find molecules meeting both criteria. Return each qualifying compound once only using set semantics. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
